```{r}
data <- read_sav("W1_AvgSleepData.sav")

# View variable labels
var_labels <- sapply(data, function(x) attr(x, "label"))
print(var_labels)

# View value labels (for categorical variables)
val_labels <- lapply(data, function(x) attr(x, "labels"))
print(val_labels)
```

```{r}

  !is.na(var_labels) & var_labels != "",
  var_labels,
  names(data) # fallback to original name if label is missing
)
```

## C1 Avg Time on Bed on Weekends

```{r}
library(tidymodels)

# Step 1: Drop rows with missing target
data_clean <- data |>
    select(-null, -null_2) |>
  filter(!is.na(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends))

# Step 2: Train/test split before any preprocessing
set.seed(123)
split <- initial_split(data_clean, prop = 0.85)
train_data <- training(split)
test_data  <- testing(split)

# Step 3: Recipe with correlation filter added
rf_recipe <- recipe(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_impute_mean(all_numeric_predictors()) |>       # Impute numeric vars
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>       # Impute categorical vars
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>             # One-hot encode factors
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.8)  # Drop highly correlated predictors

# Step 4: Random forest with permutation importance
rf_model <- rand_forest(
  mode = "regression",
  mtry = 5,
  trees = 1000,
  min_n = 5
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")

# Step 5: Build workflow
rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_model)

# Step 6: Fit to training data
rf_fit <- fit(rf_wf, data = train_data)

# Step 7: Predict on test data
rf_preds <- predict(rf_fit, new_data = test_data) |>
  bind_cols(test_data |> select(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends))

# Step 8: Evaluate
metrics(rf_preds, truth = c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends, estimate = .pred)

# Step 9: Plot variable importance
library(vip)

rf_final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(rf_fit)
vip(rf_final_model$fit, num_features = 20) + theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
prep(rf_recipe) |> tidy(number = 4)  # step_corr is the 3rd step

```

```{r}
library(tidymodels)

# --- Step 0: Combine highly correlated numeric predictors before recipe ---
combine_correlated <- function(df, threshold = 0.8) {
  numeric_vars <- df |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> select(-c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends)
  cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_vars, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cor_matrix[lower.tri(cor_matrix, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  
  high_corr_pairs <- which(abs(cor_matrix) > threshold, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  vars_to_drop <- c()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(high_corr_pairs))) {
    var1 <- colnames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[i, 1]]
    var2 <- colnames(cor_matrix)[high_corr_pairs[i, 2]]
    new_col <- paste0(var1, "_", var2, "_avg")
    df[[new_col]] <- rowMeans(df[, c(var1, var2)], na.rm = TRUE)
    vars_to_drop <- c(vars_to_drop, var1, var2)
  }

  # Drop original vars only if they were combined
  vars_to_keep <- setdiff(names(df), vars_to_drop)
  df[, vars_to_keep]
}

# Step 1: Clean and combine highly correlated predictors
data_clean <- data |>
  select(-null, -null_2) |>
  filter(!is.na(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends)) |>
  combine_correlated(threshold = 0.8)

# Step 2: Train/test split
set.seed(123)
split <- initial_split(data_clean, prop = 0.85)
train_data <- training(split)
test_data  <- testing(split)

# Step 3: Recipe (no more step_corr)
rf_recipe <- recipe(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  step_impute_mean(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

# Step 4: RF model
rf_model <- rand_forest(
  mode = "regression",
  mtry = 5,
  trees = 1000,
  min_n = 5
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")

# Step 5–9: Same as before
rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_model)

rf_fit <- fit(rf_wf, data = train_data)

rf_preds <- predict(rf_fit, new_data = test_data) |>
  bind_cols(test_data |> select(c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends))

metrics(rf_preds, truth = c1_avg_time_on_bed_on_weekends, estimate = .pred)

library(vip)
rf_final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(rf_fit)
vip(rf_final_model$fit, num_features = 20) + theme_minimal()

```
